title: Waymo plans to offer ride-hailing services in Germany, starting with Munich, by the end of 2027, marking its third international market and the first in the EU (Natalie Lung/Bloomberg)
summary: Natalie Lung / Bloomberg: Waymo plans to offer ride-hailing services in Germany, starting with Munich, by the end of 2027, marking its third international market and the first in the EU — Waymo is planning to offer driverless ride-hailing services in Germany by the end of next year, marking its third planned international market …
